import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with brand color coding
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
brands = df['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(brands))
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price with sensor type
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
markers = ['o', 's', '^', 'D', 'v']
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    sensor_data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax2.scatter(sensor_data['weight_grams'], sensor_data['price_usd'], 
               label=sensor, s=100, alpha=0.7, marker=markers[i % len(markers)])
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price vs Weight by Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Model Year Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.bar(df['brand'], df['model_year'], color=colors[:len(df)], alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Model Year by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Max ISO comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.barh(df['brand'] + ' (' + df['model_year'].astype(str) + ')', 
         df['max_iso'], color=colors[:len(df)], alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 5. Price distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.bar(range(len(df)), df['price_usd'], color=colors[:len(df)], alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(df['brand'], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Price Comparison', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Body Type Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax6.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. 4K Video Capability
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
ax7.bar(['No 4K', '4K'], [video_4k.get(0, 0), video_4k.get(1, 0)], 
        color=['#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c'], alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Megapixels by Year
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax8.scatter(df['model_year'], df['megapixels'], s=df['price_usd']/10, 
           c=range(len(df)), cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6)
ax8.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Megapixels vs Year (size = price)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 9. Summary Statistics Table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
stats_text = f"""Summary Statistics:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Avg Price: ${df['price_usd'].mean():.2f}
Avg Megapixels: {df['megapixels'].mean():.1f}
Avg Weight: {df['weight_grams'].mean():.0f}g

Price Range: 
  ${df['price_usd'].min():.2f} - ${df['price_usd'].max():.2f}

Brands: {len(df['brand'].unique())}
Cameras: {len(df)}
"""
ax9.text(0.1, 0.5, stats_text, fontsize=10, family='monospace', 
         verticalalignment='center')

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
